LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7 My No.: MO/TW/LND/08/06. Land Mini's Ref. No.: 4-3/5/2013/HW/566. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for the reconstruction of bridge No. 41/1 on the Bodagama-Hambegamuwa-Kalthota Road. Description of the land to be acquired: Schedule 1 All allotments of land depicted in sheet No. 02, Zone II of the Plan No. C.M. 720289, situated at the Village of Kotaweheramankada in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 149 C Kotaweheramankada in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Thanamalwila of Monaragala District in the Uva Province and further described as follows: Lot No. 102 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant; Government; Extent: 0.0037 Hectare.

Lot No. 103 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant; Government; Extent: 0.0250 Hectare. Lot No. 104 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant; Government; Extent: 0.0013 Hectare. Lot No. 105 Name of the Land: -; Claimant; Government; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare. Lot No. 107 Name of the Land: -; Claimant; Government; Extent: 0.0088 Hectare. Schedule 2 All allotments of land depicted in sheet No. 60 of the Interim Plan No. 62, F.T.P. 67, situated at the Village of Kotaweheramankada in the Division of Sulu in the Kongala Binthenna Korale of the Divisional Secretary's Division of Thanamalwila of Monaragala District in the Uva Province and further described as follows: Lot No. 1562 Name of the Land: Kotaweheramankada Kele; Claimant; Government; Extent: 0.0747 Hectare.

PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Thanamalwila, on the 25th April, 2025 at 10.30 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 21st March 2025 nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. THE date and time specified in the section "All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to

appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Thanamalwila, on the 24th of December 1997 at 10.30 a.m." in the notice published under Section 7 of the Gazette Extraordinary of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 991/12, dated 03.09.1997 regarding lands acquired for the Kirindi Oya project by the Government, shall be amended to "on the 25th April, 2025 at 10.30 a.m." Furthermore, the date specified in the section "and hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 10th of December, 1997, nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount "shall be amended to "on or before the 21st of February 2025".
